rubric: Evaluate the contract from the public request, issue-time owner decisions, and contemporaneous observable behavior. Require each obligation to state a supported, externally observable outcome and any material boundary explicitly resolved by the owner, including preservation of compatible behavior. Do not require particular code paths, predicates, helpers, data structures, algorithms, messages, documentation edits, refactors, fixtures, assertions, test organization, or example dimensions unless the evidence expressly makes them part of the contract. Later patches and tests may confirm outcomes, causal mechanisms, analogous cases, and non-regression, but may not retroactively mandate their implementation strategy, private-helper behavior, exact examples, broader input coverage, or hindsight-only choices. Penalize missing supported outcomes or owner-resolved boundaries, unsupported scope expansion, and compatibility regressions; accept any implementation that satisfies the evidenced observable contract.
